description:
A colored webtoon remake of the beloved 2002 manhwa, Goong! While many of the scenes and dialogue are the same as the original with updated colored artwork, changes have been made to various scenes and character designs as it is now set in 2020.

Monarchy ended long ago in Korea, but there are still other countries with Kings, Queens, princes and princesses. What if Korea had continued imperialism? What if all the beautiful palaces which are now only historical relics were actually filled with people? What if the glamorous Imperial family still maintained the palace customs? Welcome to a world where Korea still has the Imperial family living their lives! But for Che-Kyung, a high-school girl, this is a tragedy, since she has to marry the prince who turns out to be a total jerk!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55213891), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B6%81-%EC%BB%AC%EB%9F%AC%ED%8C%90/3310)
